interests.interest_detail: Life-of-mine silver stream on Lundin Gold's operating FDN gold mine, Zamora-Chinchipe, Ecuador.
interests.notes: Life-of-mine silver stream on Lundin Gold's operating FDN gold mine, Zamora-Chinchipe, Ecuador. Announced Feb 2026; definitive agreements with Lundin Gold entered April 2, 2026 (post-FY2025). Terms not yet disclosed in company filings.

interests.interest_detail: 1% NSR royalty on the Nacimiento I concession (San Juan Province), host to NGEx Minerals' 100%-owned Lunahuasi copper-gold-silver project.
interests.notes: 1% NSR royalty on the Nacimiento I concession (San Juan Province), host to NGEx Minerals' 100%-owned Lunahuasi copper-gold-silver project. Acquired July 21, 2025 from an NGEx subsidiary for US$700,000 cash. Exploration-stage; no production.
